mechanism: One pure Chunk(Bytes,Start) function returns a fixed-capacity data record and scalar Summary(Next,Length,Valid). It implements the original Step transitions until end-of-input or at least Quota source bytes have been consumed; stopping occurs only after a complete Step.

Chunk writes into a buffer bounded by source progress, independent of exact global result length: Used<=3*(Position-Start), Position-Start<=Quota+3, therefore Used<=Capacity=3*(min(Quota,N)+3). This is a single-pass local bound with scalar checked invariants.

First phase calls Chunk, rejects original strict-invalid and total Natural overflow outcomes, records at most B summaries plus starting input/output positions, and sums exact lengths. It does not retain chunk bytes after each iteration.

A local checkpoint subtype Dynamic_Predicate binds every Present entry summary to Chunk(Bytes,Start).Summary. Whole-record assignment is used; entries are immutable thereafter. Congruence of identical pure function calls establishes second Chunk summary equality, not a hash, scalar assertion of equivalence, or imported fact.

Checkpoints array has statically fixed B entries, initially PresentFalse, so default predicate checks do not scan input. Predicates are checked and proved; none are disabled. First-phase loop invariants quantify only the at-most-B scalar checkpoint records for processed Present flags, input/output adjacency and cumulative output bounds. They do not invoke Chunk or a prefix decoder.

Second phase replays Chunk from each stored exact Start, then copies its initialized prefix into the stored output interval. Immutable checkpoint predicates and pure-call congruence give exact length/Valid; scalar checkpoint bounds give result-slice safety, adjacency and final used length. No step-by-step cross-pass fold model is evaluated.

The original decoder still has a sizing/validation phase before allocating its exact public result and a writing phase. Internal mechanics change: sizing now computes/discards bounded chunk bytes, and checked predicates may replay chunks. This is not literally two total byte traversals. If exactly two traversals is binding, this alternative is ineligible until that discrepancy is resolved; no silent restatement is proposed.

fixed_budget.quota: max(4096, ceil(N/B)); compute ceil by N/B plus conditional N mod B, avoiding N+B-1 overflow.
fixed_budget.capacity: 3*(min(Quota,N)+3), using proved intermediate bounds; N=0 returns original empty result before any chunk object is needed.
fixed_budget.metadata: Exactly B checkpoint records, no per-byte or per-Step metadata. Exact record size/alignment remains a compiler readback requirement.
fixed_budget.termination: Every nonfinal successful chunk consumes at least Quota input bytes; ceil(N/Quota)<=B. Use bounded Long_Long_Integer scalar arithmetic or division to state progress without overflowing Count*Quota. Neither introduces a public input limit.

fixed_budget.peak: Budget two simultaneous fixed-capacity Chunk payloads in first phase: current result plus predicate recomputation result. Second phase also has exact final result plus chunk scratch. Function return temporaries and ABI copies may exceed this source-level envelope; compiler evidence is mandatory.
fixed_budget.eight_gib_status: UNPROVEN. B64 gives conditional two-payload192MiB+18B, plus existing caller/input/result and all process memory. fixed_budget.not_a_cap: B limits checkpoint count, not input bytes. Quota grows with N. If B cannot be met because implementation fails to consume full chunks, that is a bug/proof failure, not an allowed False return.

checked_cost.byte_work: Chunk main calls scan at most N source bytes in each phase; a predicate check can add one replay per stored checkpoint. A direct whole-record checkpoint assignment gives at most one such recomputation if expression is written as one Summary equality. Budget three full decode traversals, plus any additional object-boundary predicate checks actually emitted. All such checks remain enabled.
checked_cost.initialization: A fully initialized fixed-capacity buffer simplifies initialization proof but adds bounded full-buffer stores per Chunk call, including early invalid inputs. RelaxedInitialization is optional only after separate proof of initialized prefix/nonexposure; do not assume it is free or already supported.
checked_cost.metadata_work: For fixed B64, a processed-prefix scalar invariant has at most2080 record predicate evaluations per quantifier over the sizing loop. This is constant in N once B is fixed, with no Bytes prefix scan inside it. Several separate quantifiers multiply this finite constant; preserve actual time limits.
checked_cost.copy_work: Second phase copies each exact output byte from chunk scratch once to final result; original direct writer did not need this additional copy. Actual caller deadlines remain binding.
